items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn's Button with a loading state (a spinner over the label, and the button keeps its width) and shapes: slant leans it, and a new shape is one line.

changes: Its press, hover and open states are shadcn's radix-vega style: it presses down a pixel, and a button whose menu is open stays highlighted. Mark an icon with `data-icon="inline-start"` or `"inline-end"` to tighten the padding on that side.
A `loading` prop: the label stays in place but hidden, so the button keeps its width, with a spinner over it and `aria-busy` set.
A busy button doesn't fade the way a disabled one does.

A `shape` prop. `default` is shadcn's button, markup and all. `slant` leans the button at `--button-slant` (8.5deg if unset) and stands the label back up. Add a shape as one entry in `shape`; any shape but the default wraps the content in `data-slot="button-label"`.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: The copy button from shadcn's docs, installable: built on Button, with a fallback where the Clipboard API is blocked, icon-only or labeled, confirming for 2s.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: shadcn's Label in the theme's foreground color. It names the control it's for, and dims along with it when the Field around them is disabled.

changes: Takes the theme's foreground color, and dims with a disabled Field.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: shadcn's Field, wired: the label, description, error and success messages connect to the control on their own, and invalid, disabled and required reach it.

changes: A Field wires its control: the label points at it, and it's described by whichever description, error or success message is actually rendered.
`invalid`, `disabled` and `required` on the Field reach the control; `required` adds a marker to the label.
FieldError carries an icon and renders nothing when empty, so it never leaves a gap; FieldValid is new.
FieldDescription is a div, so it can hold a list.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: shadcn's Input with sm, default and lg sizes to match the Button. Inside a Field it wires itself up: id, description, error and disabled state.

changes: Sizes: `sm` (32px), `default` (36px) and `lg` (40px), matching the Button. A numeric `size` still sets the native attribute.
Inside a Field it picks up its id, description and state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: shadcn's Textarea that grows with its content up to a limit, then scrolls. Inside a Field it wires itself up, like the Input, with no extra props.

changes: Field wiring, and it stops growing at `max-h-64`, then scrolls.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: shadcn's InputGroup with the Input's sizes: icons, text and buttons inside one border, and a click on an addon focuses the field it sits beside.

changes: The Input's sizes on the group.
Clicking an addon focuses whichever control the group holds, a textarea included.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show/hide toggle that keeps the caret in place, and a Caps Lock warning that screen readers announce as it appears.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A whole-number field with the numeric keypad on phones, arrow-key and button steppers, and clamping to its min and max when the field loses focus.

items.name: requirement-list
items.title: Requirement List
items.description: A field's rules, shown before the first keystroke and ticked off as each is met, so nobody learns the password policy from an error message.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: Error Summary
items.description: The GOV.UK error summary: on a failed submit it takes focus, counts the problems and links each one to its field.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: shadcn's HoverCard that can load its content on intent: give it a load function and a cache key, and render the loading, loaded and error states.

changes: Opens after 120ms and closes after 100ms, tuned for previews, in place of Radix's 700/300.
Keyboard focus on the trigger opens it too.
`load` fetches the card's content the first time it opens, and `cacheKey` shares the result across cards for the session. A failed load retries on the next open.
HoverCardContent's children can be a function of the load state (`idle`, `loading`, `success`, `error`), and `useHoverCard()` reads it anywhere inside.
`onOpen` fires once, the first time the card opens.

items.name: timestamp
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: An instant in the viewer's timezone with the zone always visible; on intent, the same instant where it happened and in UTC.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: shadcn's Separator: a hairline between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, hidden from screen readers unless it's marked as meaningful.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: shadcn's Skeleton: a pulsing placeholder sized to the content that's coming, so the page doesn't jump when it arrives.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: shadcn's Spinner, for waits with no shape to hold: an animated icon that screen readers announce as Loading, sized like any other icon.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: shadcn's Empty: what goes where there's nothing yet, nothing matching, or nothing left, with an icon, a title, a description and a next step.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: shadcn's Kbd, for showing the key next to the action it triggers, and KbdGroup to set a shortcut of several keys, like Ctrl + K, on one line.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: shadcn's ButtonGroup: related actions in one row or column, joined at the borders, which works as a toolbar and can hold text, inputs and selects.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: shadcn's Dialog: a modal that traps focus while open, closes on Escape or a click outside, and hands focus back to whatever opened it.

items.name: paste-button
items.title: Paste Button
items.description: The Copy Button's other half: reads the clipboard into a field, icon-only or labeled, confirms for 2s, and tells screen readers what happened.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: shadcn's Toggle: a button that stays pressed until it's pressed again, in default and outline variants and three sizes, with aria-pressed set.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: shadcn's Select. Inside a Field the trigger wires itself up, so the FieldLabel names it and the Field's description and error state reach it.

changes: Inside a Field the trigger picks up its id, description and state.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: shadcn's Checkbox. Inside a Field it wires itself up, so the FieldLabel beside it names and toggles it, and the Field's state reaches it too.

changes: Inside a Field it picks up its id, description and state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: shadcn's ToggleGroup: a segmented control for one choice, or a row of toggles for several, joined or spaced, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: shadcn's Tabs: panels behind a row of triggers. The line variant is a full-width strip with mono labels and the active tab underlined, like the code tabs.

items.name: file-drop
items.title: File Drop
items.description: A region that takes a dropped file or one chosen from the picker, through a button or a large dashed target, and marks itself while a file is dragged over.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: shadcn's Tooltip that works without a provider around the app: a lone tooltip brings its own, and one inside a TooltipProvider uses that one.

changes: A Tooltip outside a TooltipProvider brings its own, so one tooltip needs no setup; inside a provider it uses that one.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: shadcn's Alert: a message that stays on the page and is announced when it appears, with a title, a description, an action slot and a destructive variant.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn's Card: a header, content and footer in one rounded panel, in two sizes, with a title that can be a real heading.

changes: `asChild` on CardTitle, so the title can be a heading (`<CardTitle asChild><h2>`) and the page's outline includes it.
